statement: The man serving a life sentence for murder whose escape from a Tennessee prison was reported on 2026-10-27 is apprehended, surrenders, or is confirmed dead between 2026-10-27 and 2026-11-16.
resolution: TRUE if Tennessee Department of Correction, TBI, or US Marshals officials announce that the life-sentenced inmate reported escaped from a Tennessee prison on 2026-10-27 was apprehended, surrendered, or found dead between 2026-10-27 and 2026-11-16; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The escaped inmate remains at large, neither apprehended, surrendered, nor confirmed dead, at the end of 2026-11-16.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: An earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs on the Vanuatu arc, within latitude -21 to -13 and longitude 166 to 171, between 2026-10-28 and 2026-11-30 UTC.

failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater has an epicenter within latitude -21 to -13 and longitude 166 to 171 with an origin time between 2026-10-28 and 2026-11-30 UTC.
